card.name: Opening parenthesis after a listed item
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after a drug, condition or population name in a contraindication or interaction list. The bracket adds a qualifier such as an age, a cross-reference or a route.

modes.label: Qualifier after population
modes.description: Parenthesis after a patient group or condition, giving an age or a pointer to another section.
modes.example: Neonates<< (>>28 days of age or younger)

modes.label: Qualifier after drug name
modes.description: Parenthesis after a drug in an interaction list, giving a route, a note or a cross-reference.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the bracket that opens a short qualifier after a drug or patient group in a label list.
